national.title: How to Apply for Post-Matric Scholarship in India (2026)
national.summary: Master procedure for obtaining post-matric educational scholarships from central and state governments across India. Verified guide covering National Scholarship Portal registration, Aadhaar NPCI bank account seeding, institute verification, and direct benefit transfer.

steps.title: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR)
steps.description: Visit the official National Scholarship Portal to create a unique 14-digit OTR number using the official face-authentication mobile application.
steps.calloutText: Your OTR number remains valid throughout your entire educational career for all central and state scholarship renewals.

steps.title: Authenticate via Aadhaar e-KYC
steps.description: Enter your Aadhaar number and verify identity using mobile OTP authentication or facial recognition on the NSP OTR app.
steps.calloutText: Ensure your student bank account is active and seeded with Aadhaar on the NPCI mapper for Direct Benefit Transfer.

steps.title: Select Academic Scheme and Enter College Details
steps.description: Select the Post-Matric scheme matching your category. Enter your college AISHE or DISE code, admission year, and current roll number.

steps.title: Enter Caste and Family Income Details
steps.description: Provide community certificate details and enter total annual family income as certified by the competent revenue authority.
steps.calloutText: Annual family income must strictly stay within statutory ceilings such as two lakh fifty thousand rupees for SC and ST students.

steps.title: Upload Bonafide Certificate and Fee Receipts
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of the institutional bonafide student certificate, current year admission fee receipt, and previous marksheet.

steps.title: Submit Application and Save Acknowledgement
steps.description: Review all entered information carefully and submit the application. Download and print the generated PDF acknowledgement form.
steps.calloutText: Keep your application reference number handy to track institutional and district verification stages online.

steps.title: Institutional Verification by College Nodal Officer
steps.description: Submit physical copies of your form and certificates to your college scholarship cell. The nodal officer verifies records online.

steps.title: District Officer Scrutiny and DBT Payment
steps.description: The District Welfare Officer approves the file. Scholarship maintenance allowance and tuition fees are credited to your bank account via PFMS.
steps.calloutText: Payments flow directly through the NPCI Aadhaar payment bridge without intermediate physical cheques.

documentRequirements.name: Institutional Bonafide Student Certificate
documentRequirements.description: Official certificate signed and stamped by the college principal or head of institution confirming active enrollment.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: Original signed bonafide certificate on institution letterhead.

documentRequirements.name: Revenue Authority Income Certificate
documentRequirements.description: Statutory family income certificate issued by Tehsildar, Mamlatdar, or Sub-Divisional Magistrate for current financial year.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: 1 self-attested photocopy or digital barcoded certificate.

documentRequirements.name: Caste or Community Certificate
documentRequirements.description: Official SC, ST, OBC, or EWS certificate issued by competent government authority.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: 1 self-attested photocopy with valid certificate number.

documentRequirements.name: Current Academic Year College Fee Receipt
documentRequirements.description: Official payment receipt from college showing tuition fee, library fee, and exam fee breakdown.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: Original or stamped institution fee payment receipt.

documentRequirements.name: Previous Qualifying Examination Marksheet
documentRequirements.description: Marksheet of Class 10, Class 12, or previous semester examination proving minimum passing percentage.

documentRequirements.name: Aadhaar Seeded Bank Account Proof
documentRequirements.description: First page of bank passbook or cancelled cheque showing student name, IFSC code, and account number.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: 1 self-attested photocopy of passbook first page.

documentRequirements.name: Hosteller Certificate
documentRequirements.description: Certificate issued by hostel warden or institution confirming student is staying in an approved residential hostel.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: Original stamped certificate from hostel authority.

documentRequirements.name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card
documentRequirements.description: Certified disability certificate for claiming specialized reader allowances and transport grants.

fees.label: Online Portal Application Fee
fees.description: Applying for government scholarships on official portals is completely free of charge.

fees.label: Institutional Scrutiny and Verification Fee
fees.description: Colleges and universities are strictly prohibited from charging students for scholarship form verification.

rejectionReasons.title: Bank Account Not Seeded with NPCI
rejectionReasons.description: Student bank account is active but not mapped to the Aadhaar payment bridge on NPCI servers.
rejectionReasons.solution: Visit your bank branch immediately and submit an Aadhaar seeding consent form for DBT payments.

rejectionReasons.title: Family Income Exceeds Statutory Limit
rejectionReasons.description: Annual household income on certificate exceeds prescribed threshold of 2.5 lakh rupees.
rejectionReasons.solution: Ensure total declared income aligns with official tax returns and certified tahsildar assessment.

rejectionReasons.title: Expired or Invalid Income Certificate
rejectionReasons.description: Submitting an income certificate from an outdated financial year without current validity.
rejectionReasons.solution: Obtain a fresh income certificate from your local revenue Mamlatdar or Tehsildar before applying.

rejectionReasons.title: Name Discrepancy Across Documents
rejectionReasons.description: Student name differs between educational marksheets and Aadhaar demographic records.
rejectionReasons.solution: Update your Aadhaar card details to match your high school passing certificate spelling exactly.

rejectionReasons.title: Missed Institutional Verification Cut-Off
rejectionReasons.description: College nodal officer failed to verify application details before portal deadline closed.
rejectionReasons.solution: Follow up with your college scholarship desk well before the published closing date.

rejectionReasons.title: Multiple Scholarship Application Conflict
rejectionReasons.description: Applying for multiple government scholarships providing similar tuition or maintenance benefits.
rejectionReasons.solution: Select only one government scholarship scheme per academic year to prevent system cancellation.

faqItems.question: Who is eligible to apply for the Post-Matric Scholarship?
faqItems.answer: Students studying in Class 11 and above belonging to eligible SC, ST, OBC, or EWS categories can apply.

faqItems.question: What is the family income limit for the Post-Matric Scholarship?
faqItems.answer: For SC and ST students, the annual family income ceiling is two lakh fifty thousand rupees from all sources.

faqItems.question: Is an Aadhaar seeded bank account mandatory for scholarship disbursement?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Direct Benefit Transfer credits scholarship funds solely to bank accounts linked with Aadhaar on the NPCI mapper.

faqItems.question: Can a student avail more than one scholarship at the same time?
faqItems.answer: No. Government regulations permit availing benefits from only one centrally sponsored or state scholarship concurrently.

faqItems.question: What is One-Time Registration (OTR) on the scholarship portal?
faqItems.answer: OTR is a unique 14-digit identifier generated using facial authentication to simplify future scholarship renewals.

faqItems.question: What is the difference between day scholar and hosteller rates?
faqItems.answer: Hostellers receive higher monthly maintenance allowances to cover approved college hostel and mess expenses.

faqItems.question: What should I do if my college is not listed on the portal?
faqItems.answer: Request your college administration to register on the National Scholarship Portal and obtain AISHE verification code.

faqItems.question: How can I track the status of my scholarship application?
faqItems.answer: Log in to the scholarship portal with your OTR credentials to track institutional, district, and payment disbursement status.

GJ.title: How to Apply for Post-Matric Scholarship in Gujarat (2026)
GJ.summary: Gujarat students apply via the Digital Gujarat portal for state-funded and centrally sponsored post-matric scholarships. Applications are scrutinized by institute nodal officers and sanctioned through District Social Defense or Tribal Development offices.
